limits: a decision from this store's measurement; the bound keeps any on-demand code under half a kilobyte
name: W3_gm2_decision

provenance.source: The Gödel Method: Research and Development Handover (2026-10-22), W-3

statement: Decision record for GM-2 and GM-8: the identity is the sha256 of the canonical term (as CM45 already stores); Gödel's positional code is computed on demand only for terms of at most 4096 bits (86% of today's terms), never stored, never nested; pairing tree codes are not used as identities. Adopting GM-2 amends CM43 and needs the user's yes.
